resources.string: Smaller pad = less thumb travel across the same screen. The rectangle keeps your screen’s aspect ratio. Size is its longer edge in density-independent pixels (dp). Changes save immediately; no service restart needed.

A fixed 100 ms pause distinguishes holding from immediate dragging. Add 0–2000 ms after that pause. Zero extra means 100 ms total, not instant zoom. Default: 900 ms extra, 1000 ms total. Drag before the total hold time to move the circle; hold still, then drag to pan. A quick tap still toggles persistent zoom.
Choose how visible the circle stays after it fades while idle. Lower values are more transparent; 100 percent stays opaque. Interaction restores full opacity. Changes save immediately.
